paper.title: The True Sample Complexity of Identifying Good Arms

settings.name_in_paper: Identifying an epsilon-good mean (SimplePAC / unverifiable sample complexity)
unmapped: SimplePAC (unverifiable) criterion: the algorithm never stops; sample complexity is the expected value of an analysis-only stopping time after which the recommended arm is epsilon-good for all times w.p. >= 1-delta
the learner knows the tolerance epsilon and the confidence delta but not m, the number of epsilon-good arms
settings.definition_quote: Then $\mc{A}$ is $(\epsilon,\delta)$-SimplePAC if $\forall \rho \in \mc{P}$ there exists a stopping time $\tau_{simple, \rho}$ with respect to the filtration $(\mc{F}_t)_{t \in \N}$ such that $\P_\rho( \forall t \geq \tau_{simple,\rho}: \ \   \mu_{\widehat{S}_{t}} \geq \max_i \mu_i - \epsilon) \geq 1-\delta$.

settings.name_in_paper: Identifying k of the m largest means (Gaussian, random permutation model) (lower bound)
unmapped: goal: output at a stopping time a set of k arms all among the m arms with mean > mu_1 - epsilon; covers both epsilon-good identification (k=1) and k arms above a threshold
sample complexity averaged over a uniformly random permutation of the arms; the learner may know the instance up to permutation
settings.definition_quote: Consider $n$ arms where rewards from the $i$th arm are distributed according to $\mathcal{N}(\mu_i,1)$ ... let $\tau_\pi$ be a stopping time ... at which time the algorithm outputs a set $\widehat{S}_{\tau_\pi} \subseteq [n]$ with $|\widehat{S}_{\tau_\pi}|=k$.

settings.name_in_paper: Identifying means above a threshold mu_0 (k of the m arms above threshold; FDR/FWER control)
unmapped: goal: identify k (not all) arms with means above threshold mu_0, unverifiably (anytime output set, analysis-only stopping time), under FDR or FWER error control
the learner knows the threshold mu_0, the target k and delta, but not m = |{i: mu_i > mu_0}|
1-sub-Gaussian rewards with means and threshold in [0,1]
settings.definition_quote: for a given threshold $\mu_0 \in \R$ and $k \in [n]$, minimize $\tau_k$ such that the set $\widehat{S}_t \subseteq [n]$ satisfies $|\widehat{S}_t \cap \{ i: \mu_i > \mu_0 \}| \geq \min(k,|\{i : \mu_i > \mu_0\}|)$ for every $t \geq \tau_k$ subject to $\widehat{S}_s \cap \{ i: \mu_i \leq \mu_0 \} = \emptyset$ for all times $s$ with high probability

algorithms.name: Infinite UCB Algorithm (Algorithm 1; ILUCB / IUCB), epsilon-good and FDR-TPR versions
Infinite UCB Algorithm: FWER-TPR and FWER-FWPD (Algorithm 2)
Best of both Worlds Algorithm (Algorithm 3: Algorithm 1 + LUCB(epsilon) in parallel)

symbols.k_id: number of arms the algorithm outputs (k)

conditions: algorithm outputs a set of size k at a stopping time that lies in the top-m arms with probability >= 1-delta for every permutation of the instance
sample complexity averaged over a uniformly random permutation of the arms
results.notes: Applies to both epsilon-good identification (k=1, SimplePAC) and threshold identification. Remark 1: with m means at mu_0+eps and the rest at mu_0, gives about k (n/m) eps^-2.

symbols.H_best: min over j in [m] of H_best(eps;j) = (1/j)( {sum_{i<=j} Delta_{i,m+1}^{-2} + sum_{i=j+1}^m (Delta_{j,i} v Delta_{i,m+1})^{-2}} log(n/(j delta)) + sum_{i>m} Delta_{j,i}^{-2} log(1/delta) ), evaluated at the minimizing j
symbols.Delta_j_mp1: mu_j - mu_{m+1} at the minimizing j

source.label: eps_good_theorem_paper
source.quote: Let $\delta \leq 0.025$ and $\epsilon > 0$. ... Then, there exists a stopping time $\tau$ wrt $(\mc{F}_t)_{t \in \N}$ such that \E[\tau] \lesssim  \min_{j \in [m]} \bestH(\epsilon;j) \log(\bestH(\epsilon;j) + \Delta_{j,m+1}^{-2}) and $\P( \exists s \geq \tau: \mu_{O_s} \leq \mu_1 - \epsilon) \leq  2\delta$.

results.notes: lesssim hides constants and doubly-logarithmic factors; minimum over j encoded via symbol at the minimizing j. Guarantee: after tau the output is epsilon-good for all times w.p. >= 1-2delta.

conditions: m arms have mean mu_0 + epsilon and the remaining have mean mu_0

source.quote: If $m$ arms have means equal to $\mu_0 + \epsilon$ while the remaining have means equal to $\mu_0$ then defining $\bar{\H} \coloneqq \frac{n}{m} \epsilon^{-2} \log(1/\delta)$, we have that $\E[\tau] \lesssim \bar{\H} \log(\bar{\H})$. This matches the lower bound given by $\H_{\mathrm{low},1}(\epsilon)$ up to $\log$ factors.

symbols.H_best_full: min over j of (1/j)( sum_{i=1}^m Delta_{i v j,m+1}^{-2} log(n/(j delta) log(Delta_{i v j,m+1}^{-2})) + sum_{i=m+1}^n Delta_{j,i}^{-2} log(Delta_{j,i}^{-2}/delta) ), at the minimizing j

source.label: eps_good_theorem
source.quote: Then, there exists a stopping time $\tau$ wrt $(\mc{F})_{t \in \N}$ such that \E[\tau] \leq c \min_{j \in [m]} \bestH(\epsilon;j) \log(\bestH(\epsilon;j) + \Delta_{j,m+1}^{-2} \log(\frac{n}{j\delta} \log(\Delta_{ j,m+1}^{-2}))) and $\P( \exists s \geq \tau: \mu_{O_s} \leq \mu_1 - \epsilon) \leq  2\delta$.

results.notes: Full version of Theorem 2 with doubly-logarithmic terms; c a universal constant. Proof uses delta < 1/40 though statement says delta in (0,1).

symbols.H_FDR: min over k<=j<=m of (k/j)( sum_{i=1}^m Delta_{i v j,0}^{-2} log(nk/(j delta)) + sum_{i=m+1}^n Delta_{j,i}^{-2} log(1/delta) ), at the minimizing j
symbols.Delta_j0: mu_j - mu_0 at the minimizing j

conditions: guarantee: FDR E[|S_t ∩ H_0|/(|S_t| ∧ 1)] <= 2 delta for all t, and E[|S_t ∩ H_1|] >= (1-delta)k for t >= tau_k

source.label: thm_fdr_paper
source.quote: Let $\delta \leq .025$. Let $k \leq |\H_1|$. ... for all $t \in \N$, $\E[ \frac{|\S_t \cap \H_0|}{|\S_t| \wedge 1}] \leq 2 \delta$ and there exists a stopping time $\tau_k$ ... \E[\tau_k] \lesssim \min_{k \leq j \leq m } \fdrH(\mu_0;j)  \log(\fdrH(\mu_0;j) +  \Delta_{j,0}^{-2} ) ... and for all $t \geq \tau_k$, $\E[|\S_t \cap \H_1|] \geq (1-\delta)k$.

results.notes: Gap-dependent bound (eq. fdr_bound_dep). lesssim hides constants and loglog factors.

symbols.k_id: number of arms above threshold to identify (k)

conditions: FDR <= 2 delta for all t; E[|S_t ∩ H_1|] >= (1-delta)k for t >= tau_k
results.notes: Gap-independent variant (eq. fdr_bound_indep); minimum over j taken at the minimizer.

symbols.m_good: m = number of arms above threshold

conditions: m arms have mean mu_0 + epsilon and the remaining have mean mu_0

source.quote: If $m$ arms have means equal to $\mu_0 + \epsilon$ while the remaining have means equal to $\mu_0$ then for any $k \leq m$, defining $\bar{\H}_k \coloneqq \frac{n}{m} k \epsilon^{-2} \log(1/\delta)$, we have that $\E[\tau_k] \lesssim \bar{\H} _k \log(\bar{\H}_k)$.

results.notes: Here epsilon is the margin of the good arms above mu_0, not a target accuracy.

symbols.Ht_FDR: min over k<=j<=m of (n/j) k Delta_{j,0}^{-2} log( log(nk/j) log(Delta_{j,0}^{-2}) / delta )

conditions: FDR <= 2 delta for all t; E[|S_t ∩ H_1|] >= (1-delta)k for t >= tau_k

source.label: main_thm_fdr_log
source.quote: Then, Algorithm \ref{fdr_alg} has the property that for all $t \in \N$, $\E[ \frac{|\S_t \cap \H_0|}{|\S_t| \wedge 1}] \leq 2 \delta$ and there exists a stopping time $\tau_k$ ... such that \E[\tau_k] \leq c \min_{k \leq j \leq m}  \fdrHt(\mu_0;j) \log(\fdrHt(\mu_0;j)) where $c$ is a universal constant

results.notes: Full version of the gap-independent bound in Theorem 3.

symbols.H_FWER: min over k<=j<=m of (k/j)( sum_{i=1}^m Delta_{i v j,0}^{-2} log(nk/(j delta) log(Delta_{i v j,0}^{-2})) + sum_{i=m+1}^n Delta_{j,i}^{-2} log(log(Delta_{j,i}^{-2})/delta) ), at the minimizing j

conditions: guarantee: FWER P(exists t: Q_t ∩ H_0 nonempty) <= 2 delta; E[|Q_t ∩ H_1|] >= (1-delta)k for t >= tau_k

source.label: main_thm_fwer
source.quote: Algorithm \ref{fwer_alg} has the property that $\P(\exists t : \Q_t \cap \H_0 \neq \emptyset) \leq 2 \delta$ and there exists a stopping time $\tau_k$ ... such that \E[\tau_k] \leq c \min_{k \leq j \leq m } \fwerH(\mu_0;j)  \log(\fwerH(\mu_0;j) +  \Delta_{j,0}^{-2} \log(\tfrac{n}{j}k \log( \Delta_{j,0}^{-2})/\delta) ) and for all $t \geq \tau_k$, $\E[|\Q_t \cap \H_1|] \geq (1-\delta)k$.

symbols.V_k: tilde V_k ≲ (nk/m - k) Delta_thr^{-2} log(k/delta) + k log((nk/m - (1-2delta(1+4delta))k)/delta), with loglog factors as in the paper

conditions: guarantee: FWER P(exists t: R_t ∩ H_0 nonempty) <= 10 delta; lambda_k = first time |R_t ∩ H_1| >= k (FWPD)

source.label: fwer_fdwp_thm
source.quote: Then, Algorithm \ref{fwer_alg} has the property that $\P(\exists t \in \N: \calR_t \cap \H_0 \neq \emptyset) \leq 10 \delta$ and \E[\lambda_k] \leq c \log(\widetilde{V}_k) \widetilde{V}_k.

results.notes: FWER-FWPD version; bound in terms of the minimum gap above threshold. The second term of V_k as printed lacks a Delta^{-2} factor in the theorem but has it in the lemma.

symbols.U_eps2: U_{epsilon_2}(gamma) at the minimizing gamma (complexity analogous to H_best for tolerance epsilon_2; not defined explicitly in the paper)
symbols.Delta_m_eps2_gamma: gap quantity Delta_{m,epsilon_2,gamma} (not defined explicitly in the paper)

conditions: guarantee: P(exists s >= tau_simple: mu_{i_s} <= mu_1 - epsilon_2) <= 2 delta, for any epsilon_2 > 0

source.label: thm:bobw
source.quote: There is a stopping time $\tau_{simple}$ wrt $(\mc{F}_t)_{t \in \N}$ such that \E[\tau_{simple}] \lesssim \min_{\gamma \in(0,\epsilon_2)}  U_{\epsilon_2}(\gamma)\log(U_{\epsilon_2}(\gamma) + \Delta_{m, \epsilon_2, \gamma}^{-2} ) and $\P( \exists s \geq \tau_{simple}: \mu_{\widehat{i}_s} \leq \mu_1 - \epsilon_2) \leq  2\delta$.

results.notes: Quantities U_{eps2}(gamma) and Delta_{m,eps2,gamma} are not defined in the text; presumably correspond to Theorem 2's bound.

symbols.H_eps_half: H^{epsilon/2} = sum_{i in [n]} max(mu_1 - mu_i, epsilon/2)^{-2}

conditions: verifiable PAC guarantee: at tau_PAC the algorithm terminates and P(mu of output <= mu_1 - min(epsilon_1, epsilon_2)) <= 3 delta
tuning: input tolerance epsilon_1 (the epsilon in H^{epsilon/2})

source.label: thm:bobw
source.quote: Furthermore, there exists a stopping time $\tau_{PAC}$ wrt $(\mc{F}_t)_{t \in \N}$ such that \E[\tau_{PAC}] \lesssim H^{\epsilon/2} \log(\frac{H^{\epsilon/2}}{\delta}) where $H^\gamma = \sum_{i \in [n]} \max(\mu_1 - \mu_i, \gamma)^{-2}$ and at time $\tau_{PAC}$ the Algorithm \ref{alg:BOBW} terminates

results.notes: Verifiable (PAC) stopping-time bound inherited from LUCB (Kalyanakrishnan et al. 2012, Thm 6).
